## Observations

### Fixed-bpp JPEG XL targets make same-dimension outputs nearly uniform

`verified` · `@openarc.observation.fixed-bpp-causes-uniform-same-dimension-jxl-20260821/2` · scope `path "src/interactive.rs"`

OpenArc's lossy JPEG XL presets currently use hard bits-per-pixel ceilings, so equal-dimension images converge on nearly equal file sizes regardless of scene complexity; this differs fundamentally from the former fixed-QP BPG path.

**supersedes** `@openarc.observation.fixed-bpp-causes-uniform-same-dimension-jxl-20260821/1` · **verified_by** `@openarc.evidence.uniform-fixed-bpp-inventory-20260821/1`

### Production Best completes 15-input RAW/JPEG stress run

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.best-balanced-15-input-stress-20260821/1`

The corrected production Best path completed all 15 input encodes in 1:40.35 with 3,174,392 KiB maximum RSS and exit status 0; paired ARW/JPG stem collisions left 8 distinct output paths and were logged separately.

### OpenArc Best reaches the Balanced target band

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.best-balanced-raw-rate-20260821/1`

The 6000x4000 RAW encoded to 8,930,777 bytes against a 9,000,000-byte target (0.77% under, inside Balanced's 2% band) in 12.13 s with 2,701,988 KiB peak RSS.

### RAW and JPEG XL component release profile

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.raw-jxl-component-profile-20260821/1`

On _DSC1312.ARW, raw-autotune alone took 6.06 s at 1,475,452 KiB RSS; the full best/3.0 bpp path took 18.79 s at 2,745,088 KiB, and three serialized full encodes took 54.57 s at 3,129,360 KiB.

### Kernel OOM diagnosis for RAW/JXL batch

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.raw-jxl-oom-kernel-20260821/1`

Kernel logged openarc killed at anon-rss 18,755,672 KiB (total-vm 28,394,096 KiB) on the 31 GiB no-swap host.

### RAW/JXL admission throughput comparison

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.raw-jxl-throughput-comparison-20260821/1`

The failed over-admitted run completed 5 files in about 95 s before OOM (~19.0 s/file); the bounded two-image run completed all 15 in 205.81 s (~13.7 s/file), while a serialized three-file baseline was 18.2 s/file.

**Verifies**

- `completed` `@openarc.work.bounded-raw-jxl-admission/1` — check `throughput-profiled`

### Existing outputs match the 1.50 bpp ceiling

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.uniform-fixed-bpp-inventory-20260821/1`

All 15 current 6000x4000 JXLs were 4,432,403–4,485,279 bytes, or 1.477–1.495 bpp (98.5–99.7% of the 4,500,000-byte Fast target), proving the uniform sizes are the fixed-rate contract rather than a shared memory buffer cap.

### Workspace release test gate blocked by missing vendored bins

`verified` · `@openarc.evidence.workspace-test-gate-missing-arcmax-bins-20260821/1`

The workspace gate could not start because vendor/arcmax declares five binary source paths that are absent; the targeted OpenArc/codecs release gate passed separately.
